text: How's it goin', lad?
zh: 咋样啊，小伙子？

text: I'm #:Clemens:#, the best cook 'round!
zh: 俺是#:克莱门斯:#，这一带最好的厨子！

text: Can you spare some food?
zh: 能分我点吃的吗？

text: Can you help me get past the guard?
zh: 你能帮我过守卫那关吗？

text: Do you know where Lennard's goods are?
zh: 你知道伦纳德的货在哪儿吗？

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: How ya doin'?
zh: 过得咋样？

text: Also the only cook 'round for that matter.
zh: 说起来，也是这一带唯一的厨子。

text: Here, take this stew.
zh: 来，这碗炖菜拿去。

text: But next time, you gotta pay for some.
zh: 不过下回，你可得掏钱了。

text: Of course I can, lad!
zh: 当然能啦，小伙子！

text: But why would I?
zh: 可俺凭啥帮你？

text: Hmm... Maybe, because you got me some chicken thighs?
zh: 唔……要是你能给俺弄几个鸡大腿来，那还差不多？

text: Here, take this.
zh: 给，拿去吧。

text: I don't have any.
zh: 我没有。

text: I haven't had any since Balder and his boys left with the chickens.
zh: 自打巴尔德带着他的弟兄们把鸡都带走，俺就再没吃上过。

text: Well, if you're thinkin' of me doin' you a favour. You better find some, eh?
zh: 得了，你要想让俺帮忙，最好先去找点来，咋样？

text:
Ohh my!
Would ya look at that?
zh:
哎哟喂！
瞧瞧这个！

text: This is gonna be a fine addition to my stew.
zh: 这可是俺炖菜里的好料。

text: I'll have the guard know to let you pass, lad, don't worry.
zh: 俺会跟守卫打好招呼放你过去的，小伙子，放心吧。

text: Until then, lad!
zh: 回见啦，小伙子！

text: I don't know where his goods are.
zh: 俺不知道他的货在哪儿。

text:
Go ask someone else.
Maybe Jesse can help you.
zh:
去问问别人吧。
兴许杰西能帮你。
